QA-33169 is BLOCKED: four of the five assertions pass, and the LinkedIn one can't be evaluated. I ran Monday's first row, HBO Max account and brand, on the Video Views data set. The report is at `results/2026-10-26/QA-33169-report.md`.

| Assertion | Channel | Engagements ÷ Video Views | Average-row rate | Result |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A4 | Facebook | 7.148% | 7.15% | PASS |
| A6 | Twitter | 1.987% | 1.99% | PASS |
| A8 | Instagram | 3.724% | 3.72% | PASS |
| A10 | TikTok | 2.286% | 2.29% | PASS |
| A12 | LinkedIn | no data | no data | BLOCKED |

- **LinkedIn:** HBO Max has no LinkedIn content on dev. It showed 0 posts for the default week, for 30 days, and for a full year, under both Video Views and Public. This is a test-data gap, not a product bug, and I filed nothing.
- **Unrun rows:** I did not run the other two Monday rows (Amazon Prime Video, Conde Nast/Vogue-US). Either would likely give LinkedIn coverage.
- **Skills and registry:** No skill or registry changes, since harvest handles that.
